QuestInfo.name: Golden Opportunity
QuestInfo.0: When the Protective Shield came back up, it wiped out all the Specters within it. Perhaps this could be used to take out Magnus's forces once and for all?
QuestInfo.1: It might be possible to wipe out Magnus's troops if you lure them inside of the Protective Shield and then bring it back up at the right time. Tell #b#p3000001# within Pantheon about your plan#k. You might able to turn a good defense into offense!
QuestInfo.2: #p3000001# thinks it's risky but worth trying.

0.0: You know, the Protective Shield makes an awesome weapon against Specters. If we used this as an attack, we might be able to cripple Magnus's army.
0.1: Okay, I say we use the Protective Shield to blast Magnus's army in one shot. We just have to lure them into Pantheon. Of course, if we mess up, we're doomed, but that's a risk I'm willing to take! The big question is, should I tell the others about this plan?

yes.0: This all depends on the Protective Shield, so I need to talk to #b#p3000001##k.

no.0: Man...I don't know. If this doesn't work, not even my amazing powers can save us.

1.0: This is a great victory, but we are still in danger. Do you have something to contribute to the battle?\r\n#L0##bI was thinking about an awesome trap...#l\n#k
1.1: That is indeed a risky plan. However, if we prepare well and act with great care, this could turn the entire battle around. I support your plan, Kaiser.

yes.0: We must act as though the Magic Amplifier has failed, to goad Magnus's army into invading. I will tell #p3000003# to prepare the Magic Amplifier. Please go to #p3000003#.

npc.0: I need to let #b #p3000001##k hear about my plan. I bet she'll like it.
